explanation: Department I represents the branch of production that manufactures means of production (machinery, raw materials, industrial equipment).
Department II represents the branch of social production that produces consumer goods and means of individual consumption.

targetText: This question finds its answers on the one hand in the exchange of I(v + s) for IIc, and on the other hand in the investigation, to be made later, of the reproduction of I in the annual product of I.
explanation: Social reproduction requires continuous exchange between Department I and Department II to balance industrial equipment needs with consumer wage goods.
